name: Tufrilo

social.notes: Grupos de 3–7 que trocam alertas audíveis e procuram abrigo entre raízes e tocas rasas.

ecologicalRelationships.notes: Seed caches and life-cycle ecology are proposals; 3D clips exist but no ecosystem or inventory logic is implemented.

vision.notes: Temperate understory reduces visibility; no seeing through vegetation.

hearing.notes: Alarm whistles audible to local family group; wind and obstacles attenuate sound.

smell.notes: Detects plants, seed caches and recent predator scent when conditions allow.

locomotion.notes: Hopping herbivore with powerful hind legs, short energetic escape bursts and low stamina. Gameplay tuning values.

threatResponse.notes: Does not automatically know predator location; responds to realistic nearby cues.

artDirection: Original small forest herbivore mid-poly quadruped. Compact pear-shaped moss and russet body, cream throat, large upright leaf-shaped ears, slightly oversized hind legs, short tuft tail, dorsal bristled crest, four clearly articulated paws, rounded expressive facial anatomy but not a rabbit clone. Real GLB mesh and skeleton.
notes: Protótipo 3D procedural real v0.1, 2 GLBs LOD0/LOD1 verificados, 20 ossos e 25 clipes. Fonte e viewer em assets/models/creatures/temperate-wildlife-pair-v01. Sem IA integrada, sem comportamento real de guardar sementes, sem IK e ainda pendente de aprovação visual.
